```{=html}
<div class="site-wrap submit-page">
<header class="site-masthead">
  <span class="pill">Architecture 2.0</span>
  <span class="pill hot">Benchmark submissions</span>
</header>

<section class="site-hero">
  <div class="hub-kicker">Submit</div>
  <h1>Submit a Benchmark or Workload</h1>
  <p class="subtitle">Contribute standard evaluation targets to the open Architecture 2.0 catalog</p>
</section>

<p class="site-lede">
The Architecture 2.0 Benchmark Portal is maintained as open community infrastructure. If your research group or consortium has released a hardware workload trace, kernel autotuning suite, specification-to-RTL testbench, formal verification challenge, or physical design benchmark, you can propose it for inclusion.
</p>

<section class="site-section">
  <div class="section-heading">
    <h2>Submission Criteria</h2>
    <p>Every listing in the portal must uphold the Architecture 2.0 evidence discipline.</p>
  </div>

  <div class="stat-grid" style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr)); gap: 1rem; margin: 1.5rem 0;">
    <div class="stat-card" style="background: var(--arch2-panel); border: 1px solid var(--arch2-line); border-radius: var(--arch2-radius-sm); padding: 1.25rem;">
      <div class="stat-label" style="font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--arch2-ink); margin-bottom: 0.4rem;">1. Defined Metric &amp; Comparator</div>
      <p class="stat-desc" style="font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--arch2-muted-strong); line-height: 1.45; margin: 0;">Specify measurable target metrics (e.g. Pass@k, cycle latency, WNS slack) and mandatory baseline comparators with equal compute budgets.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="stat-card" style="background: var(--arch2-panel); border: 1px solid var(--arch2-line); border-radius: var(--arch2-radius-sm); padding: 1.25rem;">
      <div class="stat-label" style="font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--arch2-ink); margin-bottom: 0.4rem;">2. Transparent Artifact Access</div>
      <p class="stat-desc" style="font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--arch2-muted-strong); line-height: 1.45; margin: 0;">Link to public repositories, datasets (e.g. Hugging Face, Zenodo), or dockerized execution environments for independent audit.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="stat-card" style="background: var(--arch2-panel); border: 1px solid var(--arch2-line); border-radius: var(--arch2-radius-sm); padding: 1.25rem;">
      <div class="stat-label" style="font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--arch2-ink); margin-bottom: 0.4rem;">3. Contamination &amp; Health Checks</div>
      <p class="stat-desc" style="font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--arch2-muted-strong); line-height: 1.45; margin: 0;">Disclose evaluation caveats, such as testbench stimulus sensitivity, null-module behavior, or memorization screening results.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="site-section">
  <div class="section-heading">
    <h2>How to Propose an Entry</h2>
  </div>

  <p class="site-lede">
  Submissions are managed via GitHub Pull Requests. Create a YAML file in <code>www/benchmarks/&lt;benchmark-slug&gt;.yml</code> conforming to the benchmark schema:
  </p>

  <pre style="background: var(--arch2-panel-soft); border: 1px solid var(--arch2-line); border-radius: 6px; padding: 1.2rem; font-size: 0.85rem; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.45;"><code>title: MyHardwareBench
url: https://github.com/my-lab/myhardwarebench
categories:
- RTL Generation # Target Workloads | Kernel Autotuning | RTL Generation | Verification &amp; Red-Teaming | Physical Design &amp; EDA | Architecture DSE
description: A 1-2 sentence description explaining the benchmark scope, tasks, and relevance to Architecture 2.0.
hardware_domains:
- Accelerators / NPUs
- EDA &amp; Physical Flows
primary_metric: Pass@1 Functional Correctness
baseline_comparator: Standard open-weight LLMs with matched prompt context and zero-shot temperature
health_audit_note: Evaluates against verified formal testbenches; screens for null reset module leakage.
authors: Jane Doe, John Smith et al.
institution: MIT &amp; Harvard
order: 99
artifact_availability: benchmark_available # runnable | benchmark_available | dataset_available | source_available | paper_only
last_verified: 2026-10-12
tags:
- Verilog
- RTL
- testbenches
- formal verification</code></pre>

  <nav class="site-actions" style="margin-top: 2rem;">
    <a class="site-action" href="https://github.com/harvard-edge/arch2/pulls" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open a GitHub Pull Request <span class="arr" aria-hidden="true">&rarr;</span></a>
    <a class="site-action secondary" href="/benchmarks.html">Back to Benchmarks Portal</a>
    <a class="site-action tertiary" href="https://github.com/harvard-edge/arch2/discussions">Ask a Question on Discussions</a>
  </nav>
</section>

</div>
```
